lineage: after Queneau's Exercices de style (1947) and Matt Madden's 99 Ways to Tell a Story (2005); no page, panel composition, line or list of theirs is reproduced

incident.title: The SERVICE key
incident.summary: Randolph station, Vermont, a September afternoon in 1937. The station agent's memo says the SERVICE door is to be opened at 4:15 with the brass key kept in the office cupboard. He gets up to fetch it. On his way a stranger at the ticket window asks him the time; he looks at the wall clock and tells her; she thanks him and goes. He reaches the cupboard, opens it, and stands before the brass key hanging in plain view on its hook, and cannot think why he came. The key stays on its hook. The SERVICE door stays closed.

participants.AGENT: the Randolph station agent (Arthur Rothstein's 1937 FSA photograph, as cut out by 99-ways-template): waistcoat, shirt sleeves, a pencil in his hand. In other media he keeps these marks: waistcoat or shirt sleeves, a pencil, the office side of the window.
participants.STRANGER: a woman traveller on the platform side of the ticket window (hat; Esther Bubley's 1943 figure on photographic pages). She is never inside the office.

objects.MEMO: a railway memo slip on the desk, pencilled: '4:15 - open SERVICE door. Key in cupboard.'
objects.CLOCK: the office wall clock; it reads 4:10 when he answers
objects.TICKET_WINDOW: the glazed ticket window between office and platform, lettered TICKET OFFICE
objects.CUPBOARD: the office cupboard; its door opens on the left jamb
objects.BRASS_KEY: a brass key on a hook inside the cupboard door, with a paper tag lettered SERVICE
objects.SERVICE_DOOR: the door marked SERVICE (a card lettered SERVICE), beside the cupboard; it never opens
objects.PENCIL: the agent's pencil; at the end it goes to his chin

question.speaker: STRANGER
question.text: Pardon me — have you the right time?

answer.speaker: AGENT
answer.text: Ten past four, by the clock.

forgetting.speaker: AGENT (to himself)
forgetting.text: Well, here I am... and what for?

events.name: the errand
events.fact: At his desk the agent has the memo before him (open the SERVICE door at 4:15; the key is in the cupboard). He rises and sets off across the office toward the cupboard.
events.must_show: the memo or an equivalent cue of the goal (the key / the SERVICE door), and his leaving the desk

events.name: the question
events.fact: On his way, a stranger at the ticket window stops him: 'Pardon me — have you the right time?'
events.must_show: a voice or figure from the platform side of the window, interrupting the walk

events.name: the answer
events.place: OFFICE (by the window, under the clock)
events.fact: He looks at the wall clock (4:10) and answers: 'Ten past four, by the clock.'
events.must_show: the clock or its time, and the answer from the agent

events.name: the thanks
events.fact: She says 'Much obliged!' and leaves the window; the interruption is over.
events.must_show: the thanks, and the window empty afterwards (or her going)

events.name: the open cupboard
events.fact: He reaches the cupboard and opens it. The brass key hangs on its hook in plain view, tagged SERVICE.
events.must_show: the open cupboard and the key visible to him

events.name: the forgetting
events.fact: Before the open cupboard, pencil to his chin, he asks himself 'Well, here I am... and what for?' He has forgotten the errand. The key stays on its hook; the SERVICE door stays closed.
events.must_show: the self-addressed line (or its declared substitute), the key unmoved, the SERVICE door closed

causal_links: the errand takes him to the cupboard
at the goal, the goal is gone
incident.outcome: goal not achieved: the brass key stays on its hook; the SERVICE door stays closed
invariants: the same two people, the same objects, the same order E0-E5, the same outcome

the four lines are spoken by the same speakers; a page may translate, rewrite, mute or replace them ONLY if its rule says so (e.g. a lipogram rewrites them, Sounds only mutes them) and its record lists the substitution
an event may be shown, implied by a stated cue, or omitted; any omission or reframing is declared in the constraint's 'declares' field and repeated in the page record

a page that changes the outcome is NOT a style of this incident; the only licensed exceptions are readings the reader performs that the page itself marks as alternate (the Fold-in fold, the ghost plan), whose unfolded/actual reading keeps the canon outcome
the clock reads 4:10 at the answer; the memo's appointed time is 4:15
incident.line_note: All four lines are the production's own. The forgetting line is deliberately ours and must never be replaced by the referenced work's punchline or by the 99-ways-template r1 line ('Now... what did I come over here for?'), which page 01 supersedes.

ordering_logic: Nine families are dealt in rounds: each round passes once through every family in the same order (layout, point of view, time, voice, genre, medium, reduction/expansion, formal rule, reader), so any eleven consecutive pages hold all nine families. The first round (pages 1-9) was chosen by hand to open with nine different media; after it, each family's order is set so that no medium appears more than twice in any batch of eleven, which keeps every batch a fair sample of families and media.

constraints.title: Template
constraints.rule: Eight panels, an objective eye-level view, every event E0-E5 shown in order with the four canonical lines.
constraints.check: A reader retells E0-E5 in order from the page alone and names who speaks each line.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The key waits
constraints.rule: Told from the brass key's place on its hook inside the closed cupboard: dark slits of light and voices until the door opens on E4.
constraints.check: A reader says the viewer is inside the cupboard; the inside of the cupboard door frames every panel.
constraints.declares: E0-E3 known only through cracks of light and lettered sound

constraints.title: Backwards
constraints.rule: The beats are drawn in reverse order, E5 first and E0 last, but each panel reads normally.
constraints.check: The first panel shows the forgetting; the last shows the memo.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Her version
constraints.rule: The stranger tells it later to a fellow passenger on the train: chatty captions in her voice, over pictures of what she saw.
constraints.check: A reader names the stranger as narrator.
constraints.declares: E4-E5 told as she imagines them

constraints.title: Noir
constraints.rule: Hardboiled first-person narration, blind-slat light, the brass key as the thing that matters.
constraints.check: A reader names the genre as crime or noir.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Turntable
constraints.rule: The beats are printed round a slotted disc that, spun, animates the walk; the page shows the disc and its reading slots.
constraints.check: A reader finds the beats in order round the disc.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Two panels
constraints.rule: The incident in two panels only: before the question, and at the cupboard.
constraints.check: A reader counts two panels and still retells E0-E5.
constraints.declares: E1-E3 and E4 compressed into two panels

constraints.title: Lipogram
constraints.rule: No letter e anywhere on the page, folio title included; the four lines are rewritten to fit.
constraints.check: No letter e (upper or lower case) appears anywhere, folio title included.
constraints.declares: lines rewritten without e

constraints.title: The memo itself
constraints.rule: The page is the agent's memo slip, both sides, the incident told in his notes, crossings-out and one doodle.
constraints.check: A reader says the page is the memo, and finds E0-E5 in its notes.
constraints.declares: E1-E5 as his later notes

constraints.title: One room, one picture
constraints.rule: The whole incident in a single panel: the agent appears several times along his path through one continuous office.
constraints.check: A reader finds the agent more than once in one frame and orders his appearances E0 to E5.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The station cat
constraints.rule: Told by the station cat on the counter, whose attention keeps drifting to the clock pendulum; the human events sit at the edge of its interest.
constraints.check: A reader names the cat as the one watching.
constraints.declares: adds a cat; human lines heard, not focused on

constraints.title: Loop
constraints.rule: The last panel leads back into the first: he returns to the desk, reads the memo and sets off again, so the page reads round forever.
constraints.check: A reader can continue from the last panel straight into the first.
constraints.declares: E0 repeated after E5 (the loop seam)

constraints.title: Only questions
constraints.rule: Every caption and balloon is a question; even the answer and the thanks are offered as questions.
constraints.check: Every sentence on the page ends with a question mark.
constraints.declares: answer and thanks recast as questions (same content, same speakers)

constraints.title: Double take
constraints.rule: Vaudeville timing: a double take at the clock, a near miss with the cupboard door, no fall; the gag is the forgetting.
constraints.check: A reader finds the double take (two consecutive head turns to the clock).
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Lightbox
constraints.rule: Translucent papers laid one over another: each later beat on a new sheet, all visible at once in fading strength.
constraints.check: A reader sees earlier beats show through later ones.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Fewest marks
constraints.rule: Each figure and object made of the fewest cut shapes that keep the incident readable.
constraints.check: A reader can count the shapes in each figure (no more than five).
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Ninety-nine words
constraints.rule: The page's text, folio and title excluded, totals exactly ninety-nine words, tallied in the margin.
constraints.check: A reader counts ninety-nine words.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Fill the balloons
constraints.rule: Every balloon is empty; the four lines wait in the margin as cut-out slips with tabs to place.
constraints.check: A reader matches each slip to its balloon.
constraints.declares: lines given as loose slips

constraints.title: One column
constraints.rule: Ten or more wide, shallow panels stacked in a single column, read top to bottom like a storyboard.
constraints.check: A reader sees one column of panels and no side-by-side panels.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Across the tracks
constraints.rule: Seen from the far platform: the station a small lit box, the figures tiny in its windows, the balloons long-tailed across the rails.
constraints.check: A reader says the viewer is across the rails and far away.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Told at dusk
constraints.rule: Framed at six in the evening: the agent at the still-closed door recalls the afternoon; the incident sits in panels inside a remembering frame.
constraints.check: A reader can separate the evening frame from the afternoon panels.
constraints.declares: adds an evening frame after E5

constraints.title: Ballad
constraints.rule: Each panel carries one rhymed couplet; the page is a ballad of eight couplets.
constraints.check: Each caption is two rhyming lines.
constraints.declares: lines set to rhyme inside the couplets

constraints.title: Libretto
constraints.rule: An opera: the lines set as sung parts under ruled staves, with stage directions.
constraints.check: A reader finds staves, role names and stage directions.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Stone
constraints.rule: A one-tone satirical lithograph with a caption beneath, the agent as a type of officialdom.
constraints.check: A reader names the print as satire and finds one tone.
constraints.declares: E0-E5 in at most four pictures

constraints.title: Inventory
constraints.rule: Every object of the incident laid out as a labelled specimen chart; numbered threads tell the story in order.
constraints.check: A reader follows the numbers from object to object to retell the incident.
constraints.declares: people shown only as their objects and lines

constraints.title: A to Z
constraints.rule: Twenty-six small captions in order, the first word of each beginning with the next letter of the alphabet.
constraints.check: The caption initials run A to Z.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Out of order
constraints.rule: Panels are scattered across the page; small numbers give the reading order.
constraints.check: A reader follows the numbers and retells E0-E5 in order.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Dealt cards
constraints.rule: Panels overlap like cards dealt one on another; each later beat partly covers the earlier, the last lies uncovered.
constraints.check: A reader orders the panels by which one lies on top.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: One fixed lens
constraints.rule: One unmoving viewpoint repeated in every panel; only the figures, the clock and the cupboard door change.
constraints.check: Every panel's background drawing is identical.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Jump cuts
constraints.rule: Consecutive panels skip unequal stretches of time, each gap stated in a caption ('three seconds later', 'forty seconds later').
constraints.check: Every panel after the first carries a stated time gap, and no two gaps are equal.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Sounds only
constraints.rule: No words at all: the story is told in sound lettering (scrape, tick, tap, creak); the lines become wordless balloons with their rhythm.
constraints.check: No word of dialogue appears; a reader still finds question, answer, thanks and forgetting.
constraints.declares: the four lines muted (shape and rhythm only)

constraints.title: How to forget a key
constraints.rule: An instruction sheet: numbered steps and arrowed diagrams teach the reader to forget a key.
constraints.check: A reader finds numbered imperative steps.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Ticket stock
constraints.rule: Told on a strip of railway card tickets, one beat per ticket, dated, numbered and punched.
constraints.check: A reader reads the tickets in number order and finds E0-E5.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Thirty-two panels
constraints.rule: Every micro-action drawn: thirty-two small panels.
constraints.check: A reader counts thirty-two panels.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Snowball
constraints.rule: Caption n has exactly n words, one to eight.
constraints.check: A reader counts 1, 2, 3 ... 8 words in the captions.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Flip corner
constraints.rule: A small flip sequence runs down the page's outer corner; flipped, it animates the forgetting.
constraints.check: A reader finds the corner sequence and its frame numbers.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: No borders
constraints.rule: No panel frames: figures, objects and balloons float on the page, ordered only by placement and tails.
constraints.check: No ruled frame line appears anywhere on the page.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Plan view
constraints.rule: Straight-down overhead view of office and platform as a floor plan; people are hat-tops and shoulders, the walk a dotted track.
constraints.check: No wall is seen standing up; a reader traces the agent's path as a line.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Meanwhile
constraints.rule: Two parallel tiers: the office above, the platform below, showing what the stranger does during each of the agent's beats.
constraints.check: A reader reads the two tiers as simultaneous and matches upper and lower panels.
constraints.declares: adds the stranger's platform actions (her arrival, waiting, train)

constraints.title: Not unlike
constraints.rule: Every caption states its fact by denying the opposite ('He was not idle').
constraints.check: Every caption contains 'not' or 'no'.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The case of the closed door
constraints.rule: A detective arrives at 4:30 and reconstructs the forgetting from clues: memo, clock, open cupboard.
constraints.check: A reader names the detective and the three clues.
constraints.declares: frames E0-E5 as a reconstruction after the fact

constraints.title: Lamp shadows
constraints.rule: Only the shadows the lamp throws on the office wall tell the story; the people themselves are never seen.
constraints.check: No figure appears except as a shadow on a wall.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The morning before
constraints.rule: The day from dawn to four is compressed into the top two tiers; the incident itself fits in the bottom tier.
constraints.check: A reader finds E0-E5 only in the bottom tier.
constraints.declares: adds the morning (how the memo came)

constraints.title: N+7
constraints.rule: Every noun of the captions and lines replaced by the seventh noun after it in our own station glossary, printed in the margin.
constraints.check: A reader checks any noun against the glossary: it is seven places on.
constraints.declares: lines transformed by N+7

constraints.title: Spot the difference
constraints.rule: Two near-identical tiers: the agent at the cupboard before and after the forgetting; the reader finds the changes.
constraints.check: A reader finds the stated number of differences.
constraints.declares: E0-E3 in a strip above

constraints.title: Clock face
constraints.rule: Twelve panels arranged round a circle like the hours of the station clock, read clockwise from twelve.
constraints.check: A reader starts at the top panel and reads clockwise; the forgetting sits just before twelve again.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Floorboard
constraints.rule: Camera at floor level: boots, chair legs, the stranger's hem beyond the counter; no face ever enters.
constraints.check: No figure is seen above the waist; a reader still retells E0-E5.
constraints.declares: faces and the key's hook seen from below

constraints.title: By the clock
constraints.rule: Every panel shows the clock, and the time between panels is a constant ten seconds, 4:09:20 to 4:10:30.
constraints.check: A reader reads a time in every panel, rising by equal steps.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Epic
constraints.rule: Captions in an inflated heroic register: the errand a quest, the cupboard a vault, the question a summons.
constraints.check: A reader names the register as heroic or epic.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Brief meeting
constraints.rule: Played as romance: glances through the glass, a lingering thanks, the lost errand as a heart's distraction.
constraints.check: A reader names the genre as romance.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Pen alone
constraints.rule: The whole page drawn in the shared pen hand alone: one line weight, no tone, no fill.
constraints.check: Only pen lines of one weight appear.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: From the hill
constraints.rule: Extreme long shots: the station small in its Vermont valley, the balloons reaching across the land.
constraints.check: No figure is taller than a tenth of its panel.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Tautogram
constraints.rule: Every word of every caption begins with K.
constraints.check: Every caption word begins with K.
constraints.declares: lines rewritten as K-words

constraints.title: Questions for the reader
constraints.rule: Beside each panel a paper hand points to a printed question for the reader ('Where is the key now?'); the answers run upside down at the foot.
constraints.check: A reader answers each question from the panels alone, then checks the upside-down answers.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Stairs
constraints.rule: Panels step diagonally from top left to bottom right, each lower than the last, a staircase down into forgetting.
constraints.check: Every panel's top edge is lower than the previous panel's.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The porter saw
constraints.rule: A porter on the platform bench watches it all and gives his partial account in captions; he cannot see into the cupboard.
constraints.check: A reader names a witness who is neither agent nor stranger.
constraints.declares: adds a witness (the porter); E4-E5 reported as he guesses them

constraints.title: The long beat
constraints.rule: Five of eight panels are given to E5: the same pose with minimal changes while the errand drains away.
constraints.check: A reader counts five near-identical closing panels.
constraints.declares: E0-E3 compressed into three panels

constraints.title: He talks himself through it
constraints.rule: The agent narrates every step aloud in his own balloons, from the memo to the forgetting.
constraints.check: Every panel has a balloon tailed to the agent.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Once upon a time
constraints.rule: A fairy tale: the forbidden door, the enchanted key, the stranger as a fairy who takes his memory with a question.
constraints.check: The text begins 'Once upon a time' and a reader names the genre.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Wall drawing
constraints.rule: Drawn in charcoal on the plaster of the station wall, the cupboard and the SERVICE door being real parts of that wall.
constraints.check: A reader says the story is drawn on a wall.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Blank middle
constraints.rule: Only the first and last beats are pictured; the middle panels are bare paper carrying only the balloons.
constraints.check: A reader finds pictures only in the first and last panels.
constraints.declares: E1-E4 carried by balloons in empty panels

constraints.title: Prisoner's text
constraints.rule: All text uses only letters without ascenders or descenders (a c e m n o r s u v w x z), lines included.
constraints.check: Outside the folio line, no letter with an ascender or descender appears.
constraints.declares: lines rewritten in the restricted letters

constraints.title: Mirror
constraints.rule: All lettering is mirror-reversed; the page reads true in a mirror.
constraints.check: Outside the folio line, every word reads correctly only in a mirror.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Window in a window
constraints.rule: Each panel sits inside the previous one, closing in from the station front to the key on its hook.
constraints.check: A reader sees each panel framed inside the last, the frames nesting toward the key.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Through his eyes
constraints.rule: Every panel is the agent's own view: his hands and pencil are seen, never his face; the stranger is heard and glimpsed through the glass.
constraints.check: A reader names whose eyes these are; the agent's face never appears.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The plan
constraints.rule: Each panel pairs what the 4:15 memo planned, ghosted in pale ink, with what happened; the ghost door opens, the real one stays shut.
constraints.check: A reader tells the ghosted (planned) figure from the solid (actual) one in every panel.
constraints.declares: adds an unrealised planned strand, marked as ghost

constraints.title: Inner voice
constraints.rule: The agent's thoughts run in cloud balloons beside the spoken lines; we watch the errand leave his head.
constraints.check: A reader points to the thought balloons and to the panel where the errand leaves them.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Showdown
constraints.rule: Framed as a frontier standoff at the ticket window, hands at the hip, the clock as the duel's timer.
constraints.check: A reader names the genre as western.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Picture sheet
constraints.rule: A 19th-century picture sheet: a grid of plate pictures, a printed verse under each.
constraints.check: Every picture has a verse below it and no balloon.
constraints.declares: lines quoted inside the verses

constraints.title: Footnotes
constraints.rule: The incident in small panels across the top third; the rest of the page is numbered footnotes on every object and word.
constraints.check: A reader finds footnote numbers in the panels and the notes below.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Panel palindrome
constraints.rule: Compositions mirror about the middle: panel k and panel 9-k share their layout, so the page folded across its middle matches itself.
constraints.check: Folding the page across its middle, each panel lies on a panel of the same composition.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Lift the flap
constraints.rule: The cupboard door is a flap the reader lifts to find the key; other flaps hide the clock and the stranger.
constraints.check: A reader lifts (or sees lifted, on the film) each flap in order.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Cover
constraints.rule: The incident told as the front cover of a 1937 story paper: masthead, one dramatic picture, cover lines that carry E0-E5.
constraints.check: A reader identifies a masthead and cover lines and can still retell the incident.
constraints.declares: E1-E3 carried by cover lines rather than drawn

constraints.title: From the platform
constraints.rule: The whole incident watched from the stranger's side of the ticket window; office events after E3 seen only through the glass.
constraints.check: A reader says the viewer stands outside on the platform.
constraints.declares: E4-E5 seen only through the window glass, the line read through it

constraints.title: Dawn to dark
constraints.rule: Twelve views of the same cupboard wall across one day; the incident fills one of them, light and clock change in all.
constraints.check: Light and clock change in every panel; the incident happens in only one.
constraints.declares: E0-E3 compressed into the 4 pm view

constraints.title: You
constraints.rule: Captions address the reader as the agent, in the second person, present tense.
constraints.check: Every caption contains 'you'; a reader says who 'you' is.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The cupboard
constraints.rule: Shot as horror: creeping dread toward the cupboard, a shock cut to the hanging key, and the horror is the blank.
constraints.check: A reader names the genre as horror.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Front page
constraints.rule: A newspaper page: headline, a press photograph, a column of report and captions.
constraints.check: A reader finds a headline and a news column carrying the events.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Stutter
constraints.rule: Every beat is drawn twice in a row, the second slightly altered, the errand already fading.
constraints.check: A reader finds panels in near-identical pairs.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Fold-in
constraints.rule: Folding the page along its marked lines hides the interruption and joins departure to cupboard, making a story in which he remembers.
constraints.check: Unfolded the page keeps the canon; folded it shows the agent taking the key.
constraints.declares: the folded reading is a marked alternate (outcome changed only when folded)

constraints.title: Quarter turns
constraints.rule: Each tier is lettered in a different orientation; the reader turns the page a quarter turn per tier.
constraints.check: Each tier reads upright only after a quarter turn.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Nine cells
constraints.rule: A strict 3x3 grid of equal cells, one beat or held pause per cell, no cell larger than another.
constraints.check: A reader counts nine cells of identical size.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: The clock's eye
constraints.rule: Seen from the wall clock: one fixed high downward view, the clock's own hand edging into the panel border.
constraints.check: A reader says the view is from high on the wall, where the clock hangs.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Thirty years on
constraints.rule: The office in 1967, disused: the key still on its hook, the door still closed; the 1937 beats appear as pale figures in the same room.
constraints.check: A reader tells the two times apart and finds the key in both.
constraints.declares: frames the incident in 1967

constraints.title: Form 99
constraints.rule: The incident told only as a railway incident report form, its printed fields filled in pencil, with the form's own sketch box.
constraints.check: A reader finds printed field names and the events in the answers.
constraints.declares: lines quoted in a 'statements' field

constraints.title: Picture book
constraints.rule: A children's picture book: large flat shapes, one simple sentence per panel.
constraints.check: Each panel has exactly one short sentence.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Two-colour stencil
constraints.rule: Only stencilled shapes in two dyes: no outline, no shading.
constraints.check: A reader counts two ink colours and finds no drawn outline.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Close-ups only
constraints.rule: Only extreme close-ups: hand, mouth, clock hand, latch, key, eye, pencil at the chin.
constraints.check: No panel shows a whole figure.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Crossing routes
constraints.rule: A 3x3 grid read across tells the agent's story and read down tells the stranger's; both meet in the centre cell at the question.
constraints.check: Rows and columns each make sense; the centre cell is the question.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Find the key
constraints.rule: One crowded panel of the station afternoon; a legend asks the reader to find the six beats in order.
constraints.check: A reader finds all six beats in the crowded picture.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Polyptych
constraints.rule: One continuous drawing of the office runs behind all the panels; the borders cut it into moments and the agent recurs in each.
constraints.check: A reader can join the panel backgrounds into one unbroken room.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Through the keyhole
constraints.rule: Seen from inside the SERVICE room through its keyhole: every panel is masked by the keyhole shape, and the door never opens.
constraints.check: Every panel has a keyhole-shaped opening; a reader says the viewer is behind the SERVICE door.
constraints.declares: E0 memo and E4 key only partly in view through the keyhole

constraints.title: Pendulum
constraints.rule: Each panel is one swing of the clock's pendulum, which crosses every gutter; the count of swings is the page's only measure of time.
constraints.check: A reader sees the pendulum alternate sides from panel to panel.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Telegram
constraints.rule: All captions in telegraphese: no articles, every sentence ends STOP.
constraints.check: Every caption sentence ends with STOP; no 'a' or 'the' appears in the captions.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Intertitles
constraints.rule: A silent picture: pantomime panels alternate with ornate title cards carrying the lines.
constraints.check: No balloon appears; every line is on a title card between pictures.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Engraved plate
constraints.rule: A steel-engraved catalogue plate: figures and objects numbered and named in a lettered key ('Fig. 4, the key').
constraints.check: A reader finds numbered figures and a key that names them.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

constraints.title: Six words
constraints.rule: Six panels, each captioned with a single word; no balloons.
constraints.check: A reader counts exactly six words on the page outside the margin.
constraints.declares: the four lines replaced by six single words

constraints.title: Short words
constraints.rule: Every word on the page has one syllable.
constraints.check: No word on the page has two syllables.
constraints.declares: lines rewritten in one-syllable words

constraints.title: Marginalia
constraints.rule: Page 01 reprinted small with an annotator's pencil notes pointing to the evidence for each event.
constraints.check: A reader finds a note pointing to every event E0-E5.
constraints.declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome
